reason: I'd maybe start the trial like I do with everything, but three days is not enough time to see a single reply from cold DMs, and I'd cancel on day 3 rather than get billed. Zero published results and 7 of 100 'founding seats' reads like a launch, not proof.
objection: A 3-day trial that bills on day 4 with payments final feels like a trap, and I can't judge whether it books calls in 3 days. I also have no proof it works and I'm putting my own Instagram account on the line.
would_change_my_mind: A 7 to 14 day trial, or a refund window after the first charge, plus a few real agency owners showing booked calls from it.
